system.description: A benefit keyed to your unarmed strikes' current Category, and multiple Categories stack their benefits: arcane, brawling, dagger or thrown reads target Defense off their Insight die · bow or sword adds 5 damage on multi-target attacks · firearm or heavy adds 5 against constructs and the shield-and-armour-clad · flail or spear grants +2 Defense and reach into the air.
